notes.auto_language_detection: Reads selectable text outside each embedded table image to choose chinese_cht, pt, or en OCR recognizers.
notes.amount_policy: Preserve original OCR strings; suspicious OCR substitutions are flagged for human review, not silently corrected.
notes.table_columns: Detects the two internal vertical rules from the embedded table image; uses fixed fallback fractions if line detection fails.
